$comment: Pre-merge Lighthouse budget, graded against a LOCAL production build by scripts/check-lighthouse-budget.mjs. This is a relative gate: absolute web-vitals thresholds are meaningless without network latency, so it compares each route to a committed known-good baseline. Refresh only through the CI refresh artifact after an intentional, known-good run. Distinct from .github/workflows/live-web-vitals.yml, which measures the deployed origin. Enforcement was promoted after complete pinned-browser baselines on 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-13 remained within tolerance.
$lighthouseVersion: Pinned exactly, not `lighthouse@12`: a patch published between a baseline run and its follow-up would silently change the measurement. Kept in step with LIGHTHOUSE_VERSION in .github/workflows/live-web-vitals.yml by tests/check-lighthouse-budget.test.ts so the two Lighthouse entry points cannot drift apart.
